title: ERROR: the server refuses or ends a Relay session (spec 5.4)
description: Sent just before the server closes the connection with the matching close code.

code.description: UNAUTHORIZED (close 4001): missing, unknown or revoked API key. TENANT_MISMATCH (4003): the HELLO keys do not match the key's tenant. UNSUPPORTED_VERSION (4006). BAD_FRAME (4400): a frame was not valid. REPLACED (4009): the same node id connected again.
